thread:
Rhea (product): Launching v3.7.0 onprem: Operator Evidence + Delegated Ops SLA notes. Opt-in for Private/VPC installs. Main pieces: verifiable local evidence bundles, scoped operator identities, emergency host fallback with SLA safe window.

Rhea (product): TL;DR for customers: opt-in migration, dry-run available, signed bundles for auditors, fallback keeps apps running during auth disruptions.

DeployBot: Rollout started: v3.7.0-onprem-evidence -> canary ap-northeast-1 at 3765432200

Cal (eng): Technical: evidence bundles are generated on request or scheduled, signed with a local key, and include per-session metadata + integrity hashes. We emit metrics: evidence.generate.latency, fallback.count, delegated.auth.failures.

Jin (security): Compliance note: Recommend HSM/KMS for local signing keys for customers needing FIPS. For SOC2 customers, enable attestations and set operator key rotation -> 90d. We'll include a sample auditor checklist.

Rhea (product): Opt-in UX: Console toggle + CLI `redwoodctl access enable-delegated --dry-run`. Migration assistant will show role mapping report. No forced changes.

Ava (docs): Adding KB and a customer readiness checklist. Can you drop the exact CLI snippets you want in the KB?

Cal (eng): CLI snippets for KB:
```
# dry-run migration report
redwoodctl access enable-delegated --dry-run

# generate an evidence bundle and export
redwoodctl evidence generate --scope operators --output ./evidence.tar.gz
redwoodctl evidence verify --file ./evidence.tar.gz
```

Marco (sales): Sales ask: what's the short compliance blurb I can use with enterprise accounts?

Rhea (product): Quick blurb: "Onprem Operator Evidence provides a verifiable, on-site audit artifact and role-scoped operator access so your auditors get evidence without telemetry leaving your VPC. Migration is opt-in and dry-run supported."

Jin (security): Addendum: fallback events are logged into the bundle and surface as high-priority alerts in Console. Customers should configure the emergency window (we suggest 24-72h) and a notification hook to their incident system.

Cal (eng): Fallback behavior: if delegated auth fails we escalate to host emergency operator for the configured window, then block further operator actions until resolved. All fallbacks are counted and exported.

DeployBot: Canary complete at 3765432360, monitoring window 3h.

Ava (docs): Draft KB pushed, includes CLI, migration checklist, and auditor checklist. PR link in #docswhenready.

Marco (sales): I'll start pilot emails tomorrow with the blurb and link to KB.

Rhea (product): Action items: Rhea publish the GA announcement if canary metrics look good; Cal run staging migration; Ava finalize KB; Jin add HSM guidance; Marco pilot outreach. Please react with :thumbsup: when done.
